W46

Learner allowances

/teach/courses/:courseId/people/:learnerId/allowances
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S21

Record instructor-authorised operational exceptions with explicit scope and learner-visible effective timing.

Entry and return
W45 learner recordW49 extension/excuse handoffW40/W41 timing review
Layout regions
Incoming academic requestsAssignment/quiz/person, requested change, learner reason, current personal rule, request status/version and prior decision.; Separate pending requests from granted allowance records; no medical documents or direct-message thread.
HeaderLearner, course, active allowances and history
AdjustmentAssessment or course scope, effective dates and before/after timing
Privacy/previewLearner view, staff operational view and instructor-only basis reference

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Record learner exception
  • Affected work, personal due/close/timer and effective time
  • Learner-visible wording; basis remains instructor-only
Return without applying changesRecord reviewed allowance
Permissions
  • Instructor alone creates, replaces or ends allowances and reads basis references.
  • TA may read operational timing only for currently assigned learners/work; no private basis.
  • Learner sees their own outcome through W19/W25, never this staff route.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
  • Typed request ID/version/status and learner-visible response linked to resulting allowance or decline, separate from instructor-only basis reference.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Assignment extension never extends an unrelated quiz.
  • TA sees effective timing only and cannot create/modify allowances.
  • If a preview becomes stale, recording is blocked and previously received work remains unchanged.
  • Approve/decline updates the same W19 request and its notification without a private inbox; declining preserves current dates.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • Proposed quiz deadline = earlier of personal close and startedAt + effective duration; untimed quiz ends at personal close. Show a shortened window before Start. Use one timer allowance mode (extra minutes OR multiplier), not both. At expiry finalize only acknowledged answers; unsent offline text remains a recoverable local draft requiring staff review, never a fake accepted receipt.
